senses.gloss:
(I)--a son of ब्रह्मा, born of his back.
1: भा. III. १२. २५.
Had for his wife म्र्षा.
2: Ib. IV. 8. 2.
Three chief characteristics--pride, luxury and intoxication.
3: Ib. I. १७. २४.
His son was Dambha and daughter माया, both of whom were adopted later on by the [page१-046+ ३३] childless निरृति.
4: Ib. IV. 8. 2.
Five branches of: विधर्म, परधर्म, आभास, उपमा, and छल।
5: Ib. VII. १५. १२-14.
(II)--wife, हिम्सा; sons निकृति, अनृत. (daughter निकृती-वि। प्।). Br. II. 9. ६३; वा. १०. ३९; Vi. I. 7. ३२.

--the name of a hell: also अधोमुखम्। He who receives bad gifts and from forbidden persons, who lives by astrology and those who do not request for sacrifice go to it. Br. IV. 2. १४८ & १६३; वा. १०१. १४७, १६१; Vi. II. 6, 4 & १८.
--one of the seven sons of वसिष्ठ. वा. २८. ३६. [page१-157+ २९]
--By this अविकारस् became विकारस्। Earth, etc., are विकारस्। Br. II. १९. १८१-2.
